_meta.title: Concept Interactions — complementary and conflicting knowledge-base objects relevant to strategy construction
_meta.purpose: Identify (a) documented confluences that strategies may stack, (b) documented conflicts / unresolved variances that must be frozen as explicit research parameters, and (c) dependency chains that forbid removing a component.

complementary.relationship: FVG formed during the displacement that later sits inside the OTE of the same leg = strong confluence (depth + imbalance + correct range half). Prefer the FVG overlapping OTE closest to 70.5%.
OB overlapping OTE -> OB ∩ OTE is the refined entry; invalidation = more conservative of OB extreme or 79%.

OB + FVG overlap = institutional origin candle inside the imbalance of the same displacement; OB after a liquidity raid that originates the displacement = highest quality; OB that is the last opposing candle before an MSS-producing displacement is structurally validated.

The canonical sequence: liquidity event -> displacement -> MSS -> retracement into displacement array -> continuation to DOL. Each link is a dependency (removing one changes the model into an unvalidated approach).
Asia = accumulation, London Open = manipulation, London continuation/New York = distribution; the session PO3 nests inside the daily PO3 and times the entry.
Asian high/low are the day's first marked BSL/SSL pools and the pools most likely raided at London Open.
Nested arrays: LTF FVG/OB forming inside an HTF FVG/OB after an LTF liquidity event and displacement = highest-probability location; HTF supplies context, LTF supplies precision.

Bullish arrays graded highest in discount, bearish in premium; SSL in discount is the natural bullish-narrative origin, BSL in premium the natural bearish origin; DOL is chosen consistent with bias and location.
SMT at the liquidity extreme followed by displacement + MSS on the traded instrument = confirmation; SMT alone = warning only.
Daily PO3 aligned with weekly structure, weekly DOL and controlling-range discount/premium = high confluence; opposing daily PO3 = corrective day, lower probability.
A PD array coinciding with an old swing / prior day-week-month high-low carries additional contextual weight (not a requirement).
Daily bias is authorised only after the named London sweep + displacement + MSS prints — prevents entries during accumulation/manipulation.

dependency_chains_do_not_remove.chain: Sweep -> Displacement -> MSS -> Array -> Retracement -> Entry -> Target
dependency_chains_do_not_remove.rule: Removing any link produces 'a different, unvalidated approach that happens to share some of its vocabulary' (BEG-M13-NT01); FVG without displacement is 'just a gap' (BEG-M05-R03); MSS without sweep is weaker (BEG-M11-R01); entry without target is not a complete idea (BEG-M11-R01).
dependency_chains_do_not_remove.note: Ablation arms in CT-05/CT-09/CT-10 deliberately violate this to MEASURE the book's claim; they are research controls, not proposed strategies.

dependency_chains_do_not_remove.rule: The LTF never generates independent bias; timeframe conflict resolves in favour of the HTF (INT-M08-R03, ADV-M09-R01).
Bias without a named Draw on Liquidity is incomplete; no directional model authorised under unclear bias.
Distribution models are forbidden during accumulation / early manipulation.
